% --- latex-dual-layer macros (auto-generated) ---
\newlength{\dlboxwidth}
\newlength{\dlboxheight}
\newlength{\dlboxdepth}
\newcommand{\duallayerbox}[2]{%
  \begingroup
  \settowidth{\dlboxwidth}{\strut #1}%
  \settoheight{\dlboxheight}{\strut #1}%
  \settodepth{\dlboxdepth}{\strut #1}%
  \ifdim\dlboxwidth=0pt
    \settowidth{\dlboxwidth}{#2}%
  \fi
  \raisebox{0pt}[\dlboxheight][\dlboxdepth]{%
    \makebox[\dlboxwidth][l]{\resizebox{\dlboxwidth}{!}{\strut #2}}%
  }%
  \endgroup
}

\section*{Multiple Choice (10 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item The effects of iron on certain aspects of socio-emotional development (shyness,
orientation/engagement and response to unfamiliar pictures) is due to:
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item The role of iron in serotonin production
    \item None of the above
    \item The role of iron in neurochemistry
    \item The role of iron in maintaining blood sugar levels
    \item The role of iron in muscle function
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Consanguinity shows a strong association with which pattern of inheritance?}{Which pattern of inheritance is characterized by transmission exclusively through the maternal line regardless of the father's genotype?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Codominant inheritance
    \item Mitochondrial inheritance
    \item Y-linked recessive
    \item X-linked dominant
    \item Autosomal dominant
\end{enumerate}
\item Which products of ADP degradation increase in concentration in the blood during multiple
sprint sports?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Ammonia, urea and creatine.
    \item Ammonia, hypoxanthine and creatinine.
    \item Ammonia, creatine and uric acid.
    \item Urea, creatine and uric acid.
    \item Ammonia, urea and uric acid.
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Which of the following structures should be visible on a dental panoramic radiograph?}{Which of the following best represents the full range of maxillofacial structures typically captured on a standard dental panoramic radiograph?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Only the mandibular canal and hard palate
    \item The mandibular canal, maxillary sinus, hard palate, zygomatic arch, and ethmoid sinus
    \item The mandibular canal, maxillary sinus, hard palate, zygomatic arch, and frontal sinus
    \item The mandibular canal and maxillary sinus
    \item The mandibular canal
\end{enumerate}
\item A patient suffers a broken neck with damage to the spinal cord at the level of the sixth
cervical vertebra.
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item It is impossible to predict an effect on breathing.
    \item Their breathing rate will significantly increase.
    \item They will only be able to breathe quietly.
    \item Their breathing will be erratic and unpredictable.
    \item They will be unable to breathe without life support.
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}

\section*{True / False (10 marks)}
\textit{Answer True or False}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\setcounter{enumi}{5}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{Motor neuron cell bodies are primarily located in Lamina V of the spinal cord.}{The primary visual cortex is located in the occipital lobe of the brain.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{Acyclovir is an antiviral medication specifically used to inhibit herpes viruses.}{Acyclovir is a broad-spectrum antibiotic primarily used to treat bacterial sepsis.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{Impulses for pain travel primarily through the dorsal columns of the spinal cord.}{Fine touch and proprioceptive information travel primarily through the dorsal columns of the spinal cord.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{If survival time with a disease increases, the prevalence of that disease in the population will also increase.}{If the incidence of a disease decreases to zero, the prevalence of that disease in the population will immediately drop to zero as well.}
\item True or False: Saliva contains enzymes that primarily act on proteins, facilitating their digestion before they enter the stomach.
\end{enumerate}
